attributes.title: 2027 AANS Annual Scientific Meeting
attributes.summary:
The 2027 AANS Annual Scientific Meeting, themed "Navigating the Impossible," runs April 9 to 12, 2027, in San Diego. Registration and housing booking are open on the meeting site; abstract submission closed on October 4, 2026.

Early-bird rates run through January 7, 2027: $1,099 for AANS member physicians and $499 for member allied and advanced-practice team members. Advance rates ($1,299 and $599) apply through March 4, 2027, which is also the housing deadline, and late rates start March 5. Non-member neurosurgeons pay $2,299 at every stage.

AANS has not yet posted a 2027 CME credit statement, and the pages we read do not name the meeting venue.
